description: The New York Fed's reference rates: EFFR and OBFR (unsecured), SOFR, BGCR and TGCR (secured), and the SOFR averages and index (SOFRAI). With no rate, the latest of each; with a rate, its last N days, with percentiles, volume and, for EFFR, the target range.

last.description: How many days of history, when a rate is given.

rate.description: One rate, for its history. Omit for the latest of all.

name: get_reference_rates
title: New York Fed reference rates
